description: Project-authored cases covering every event category for deterministic regression testing.

cases.text: Sanctions and armed conflict disrupt Northstar Energy shipments and create losses.
A recession and higher interest rate outlook raise losses for Aurora Bank.
Aurora Bank reports a missed payment and default in a lending portfolio.
Northstar Energy announces an acquisition expected to support profit growth.
Aurora Bank launches a new platform after approval, supporting growth.
A regulator imposes a fine and penalty on Northstar Energy.
A cyber breach causes an outage at Atlas Manufacturing.
Meridian Shipping reports stable operations with no major changes.
